basic_info.headline: Software Engineer at Odaseva ❖ Next-gen data & DevSecOps tooling
basic_info.about:
Experienced cross-functional leader in implementing SaaS solutions at enterprise scale. Certified in Salesforce platform architecture, configuration, and development with a focus on customer data management and DevSecOps success.

Trusted by Salesforce customers, SIs, and ISVs alike as a product owner, technical architect/lead, and consulting partner:

# Thought Leadership
Enterprise SaaS Ownership & Governance
DevSecOps & Change Management Strategy
Software Architecture Best Practices
Developer Onboarding & Mentorship

# Software Development Projects
Salesforce Applications
- Branded Frontend Components (LWC, JS, CSS)
- Platform Automation (Apex Triggers, Apex Web Services, Flows)
- Legacy Products (Visualforce, Aura, Process Builder, Workflow Rules)
- Managed Packages (1GP & 2GP, Security Reviews)
AWS-hosted Backend Functions
- RESTful APIs
- Node.js & TypeScript
- Serverless -> Lambda
- AWS S3 & DynamoDB
- GitLab CI

# Salesforce Product Implementation
Sales Cloud
Service Cloud
Lightning Experience Migration
Experience Cloud (Communities/Sites)
- SSO Implementation
- Customization Strategies
Platform Integrations
- ERP systems
- Slack
- Microsoft Teams

# AppExchange Solution Implementation
Odaseva
- Restore Readiness Audit
- Restore Test Assistance
- Archiving
- Sandbox Seeding
DocuSign
Conga Composer
Accounting Seed

# Application Development Lifecycle
Salesforce DX Implementation
- Source-based Development (Scratch Orgs)
- Automated Testing (Apex, Jest)
IDE Implementation & Training
- Visual Studio Code
- IntelliJ IDEA / WebStorm & Illuminated Cloud
Version Control & CI/CD Implementation
- GitLab, GitHub, Bitbucket
- Bash & YAML scripting
- CumulusCI

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
experience.description:
Build data security and Zero Trust solutions on the Odaseva platform to serve Salesforce customers.
Coach scrum team on agile best practices and lead ceremonies (standup, sprint planning, retros).
Serve as internal SME on Salesforce topics (LDV, Managed Packages, DevOps, TypeScript integration).
Mentor junior developers in code practices and career progression.

experience.title: Technical Architect, Expert Services
experience.description:
Deliver Odaseva implementation projects for enterprise customers:
- Lead discovery sessions to determine org-specific data challenges.
- Build end-to-end solution using the Odaseva platform.
- Perform knowledge transfer of solution to customer.
Support Salesforce expertise across CSG, Product, and Sales teams.
Develop new programs and materials for Expert Services engagements.
Provide feedback to Product team to support platform roadmap.

experience.title: Senior Consultant, Global Salesforce
experience.description:
Perform the following roles for enterprise projects on the Salesforce platform:
- Platform Solution Architect: Partner directly with client stakeholders on requirements and document solutions.
- Delivery Solution Lead: Apply Agile processes in Jira to develop & test application components as a team.
- Engineering Lead: Establish best practices for dev teams, support build work, mentor junior devs.
- DevOps Engineer: Build version control & CI/CD processes to streamline Salesforce deployments.
- Application Integration Engineer: Build integrations with external REST/SOAP APIs following Salesforce best practices.

Support Salesforce practice activities:
- Act as SME for Salesforce DevOps and custom code-based solutions.
- Lead practice-wide presentations on topics such as delivery best practices.
- Interview prospects and mentor new hires.

experience.title: Salesforce Developer
experience.description:
Develop Force.com applications and integrations (Apex, Visualforce, Lighting Components)
Support sales, customer care, and delivery services teams using Salesforce.
Manage workflows and best practices for the Salesforce application development team.
Work directly with high-level corporate stakeholders on Salesforce-oriented projects.

experience.title: Salesforce Consultant
experience.description:
Provide expertise on current Salesforce offerings and integrations.
Attend community user group events, sharing best practices and solutions with attendees.
Be a resource for best practices using Salesforce in a SMB environment.
Outline and execute customizations to Salesforce, including reports and dashboards, custom fields, workflows, and APEX/Visualforce.
Implement Slack, Google Apps, and other SaaS applications.

experience.title: Business Analyst & Cloud Systems Administrator
experience.description:
Working directly with management to design reports and dashboards for business insights.
Administrating and managing enterprise cloud software such as Salesforce, Desk.com, Slack, and Trello.
Integrating data and workflows between project management, CRM, financial, ERP, and customer support software.
Utilizing Excel and Salesforce to monitor database health and migrate data between platforms.
Spearheading projects to rethink business processes and implement in-house or third-party solutions to support business growth.
Developing and deploying Salesforce processes and workflows to guide employees and reduce repetitive data entry.

experience.title: Online Operations Strategist
experience.description:
Administrating users and data on cloud software platforms such as Salesforce, Desk.com, and WooCommerce
Developing company-tailored workflows within cloud platforms (APEX for Salesforce, Rules for Desk.com, HTML/CSS for WooCommerce)
Migrating legacy data and workflows into new cloud platforms (most recently: Peachtree Accounting to Accounting Seed)
Integrating old and new operational platforms, including a tailor-made Aastra IP phone connection for Salesforce
Training team members on best practices for cloud software usage
Researching and implementing new cloud-based solutions to improve internal operational workflows

experience.title: Broadcast Technician
experience.description:
Configured and installed digital broadcasting equipment from vendors such as Harmonic, Thomson, Dell, DVEO, and more.
Assisted the engineering team with equipment shipments, testing, and configuration.
Provided technical support on PCs and various software, including TeamViewer.
Developed documentation and instructional media for both internal and external use.
Produced tutorial videos for Harmonic digital broadcasting equipment using Camtasia and Adobe Creative Cloud software (Premiere, Audition, Photoshop, Illustrator).

education.degree: Bachelor of Science - BS, Business Administration and Management, General
education.description: OU Presidential Scholarship, Dean's List (Fall '10, Spring '11, Fall '11 & Fall '12), Cum Laude
education.activities: Chi Phi Fraternity, SGA (Senior Senator), Pegasus Creative, University Singers, The Stormy Petrel, Alpha Chi Honors Society, IFC (Interfraternity Council)
International Club, The 19th Annual Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot (co-writer and editor of two entry memoranda)

projects.name: OUC English Lecture Series Website
projects.description: A website for the English Lecture Series hosted by Professor Shawn M. Clankie of Otaru University of Commerce in Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan. It features a list of upcoming and previous lecturers, a video archive of past lectures, and an application form for individuals that are interested in giving a lecture as part of the series. Built in Wordpress.
projects.associated_with: 小樽商科大学 / Otaru University of Commerce

featured.description:
Are you coming to #TDX24? Do you build custom web apps on the Salesforce platform? Or are you just curious about code?

Then check out my upcoming talk on well-architected client-side applications with LWC and #TypeScript! I'll share how I've made my projects at Odaseva easier to maintain using type-checking, third-party libraries, and thorough unit testing.

If this piques your interest, favorite my session today! Link in the comments.

featured.title: Odaseva Webinar
featured.description:
In a few weeks, I'll be speaking to Senior Technical Architect Arun Sood from Salesforce about how to vet your data backup solution. As your Salesforce implementation scales up, the capability to both backup and restore becomes more essential...and more complex. Does your process take Arun's five considerations into account?

Register below, and I'll see you there!

featured.title: Tech Debt The Silent Org Killer
featured.description: Wrote an article about lessons learned from my early days as a Salesforce admin. Thank you Amit Chaudhary for the opportunity to share!
